reviews.t: These are really large and smell amazing!
reviews.x: I ordered these for shower favors. These smell AMAZING and are much larger than I thought they would be. Reasonably priced and packaged perfectly. I will keep them in the box it came in for display. These appear to be high quality. I'm hoping that I will get to try one out to see how they feel.

Really work well. We bought these for my son who sometimes needs a push to take a bath. He is 30.  Just kidding- he is 7. The colors are vibrant and the bombs fizz like an alka-seltzer. My wife has used a couple and said they leave her skin feeling very soft- I would agree with her assessment- her skin seems pretty soft.  We will purchase these again.

We buy these because our 3 yo daughter likes them. The product is nice although the colors that arrived were not the same as the picture on amazon. The dark grey “black tea” left this in our tub. After 3 rinses with hot water and wiping it down it looks like we will have to scrub it off.

reviews.t: My daughter LOVES these bath bombs!
reviews.x: My four year old daughter loves bath bombs. She has very sensitive and dry skin. We have tried many different lotions with mixed success. Around the holidays, I purchased some of those expensive, designer bath bombs from that store in the mall. I'm sure you know the one. Their product worked well for my daughter's dry skin, but it was so expensive, I could not keep buying them at the rate she used them. That's when I started looking online for a comparable product, and I am so happy I found Nurt

If zero stars was an option, I’d use it. These have absolutely NO smell, do NOT fizz, and are just a total disappointment. They are just baking soda and coloring. Used the one marked Black Tea and that was exactly the sediment in left on the floor of my tub...not to mention the color it left on my white washcloth. They offered me refund of HALF price to change my star rating, but bad product is exactly that!! Bad product. Absolute WORST purchase I’ve ever made from amazon!!!!

reviews.t: These bath bombs are the bomb!
reviews.x: I bought these for my 4yo daughter who likes taking baths, instead of showers, 2-3 times a week.  Me and my wife had picked some up at various local stores but most of those were horrible with bits of "organic" material, like oatmeal or whatever, floating all around in the bathwater.  Others barely had any scent and wouldn't hardly tint the water.  We were getting those for between $3-$5 each.  She just had a birthday and I saw these & read the reviews so I thought for under $1 each, they were w

Most awesome bath bombs ever!!! I’ve used many bath bombs an d these surpass all. My grandson suffers from chronic pain issues.Besides the fact that they help him relax the colors are soft and soothing.They look natural not like some with bright artificial colors. He loves holding them as they dissolve. He wants to take baths more often now ;as he feels so much better afterwards. I’ve used them myself and honestly I can almost fall asleep in the tub. The price is so fair for an organic product.

reviews.t: A must buy! Smells amazing and leaves skin smooth!
reviews.x: So amazing and beyond glad I got this purchase for my baby girl! It smells amazing and leaves their skin feeling silky smooth. A must buy!
Very cheaply packaged if you are wanting them to give to other people it seems cheap.

Never will I ever buy these again they all smelled the same an didn’t barely turn my bath any color an after getting out they dried my skin out terribly and while in the tub they were itchy and I’m not skin sensitive usually so the itching and dry skin isn’t because I’m sensitive at all just bad products
These bath bombs were just ok!  I've had ones that make the water softer and have a longer smell.  I wouldn't buy again..
This is a great value for the amount of bombs you get. They’re the smaller sized ones but are super fragrant and really long lasting. I’ll definitely buy again!
These are such nice bath bombs. They are large in size and bubble a long time in the tub. They all smell so good.

My daughter in love ❤️ with this bath bombs, the smell and picking different color and mood you want. My daughter is 6 she is picky we went threw two different companies. This has been far more better and best part it's natural it didn't stain my tub. I will be ordering again.

My son loved the bath bombs I had purchased from a store. So I went online looking for a big lot of them for a better value! I found these! They arrived within two days thanks to amazon prime! My son has a very heightened sense of smell. He is also brutally honest when it comes to a smell that he doesn’t like. We went through all of them one by one and smelled them. He absolutely loved every scent there was! I was so delighted by this find! It had a great value for all the product that came with

reviews.t: Smells wonderful and good for sensitive skin
reviews.x: My 4 year old son has been begging for bath bombs because of the bath bomb craze. He has extremely sensitive skin with occasional eczema breakouts. These bath bombs did not give his skin any reactions. Personally I am not a fan of perfumey scents and the scents of these bath bombs are very pleasant. I will definitely be purchasing again.
Colors weren't as bright as I was expecting, but nonetheless these bath bombs are awesome! I use a lot of bath bombs, and these were some of my favorite. They smell amazing!
Bought it for my kids who love to take tubs and use them . The scents were awesome and kids loved them .. for the price I think it’s good . I would buy again ..

reviews.t: Nice product, but has some things to consider- read the review
reviews.x: This gift set contains 40 “medium” sized bath bombs. Each bath bomb fizzed very well and the scent is amazing! However, every single bath bomb smelled exactly the same regardless of their label, color and individual shrink wrap. Also the box says organic, but there is “NO” USDA Organic stamp on the product, so technically it is not considered organic. It would be better labeled “Natural”. I feel that $40 was a bit high considering everything mentioned in this review, but overall I am not disappo

We used these for our Baby shower favors. Most of the scents were nice such as the coconut and the floral scents but couple of them were very artificial and reminded me of cheap perfume. Luckily the children who attended wanted those ones because let's be real... everybody loves bath bombs! The packaging was so nice I used it to display the bath bombs versus the basket I had intended to use. It came nicely packed and it shipped quickly. I highly recommend this product for baby showers and bridal

reviews.t: Price is right when you need a lot
reviews.x: I purchased these to put in Easter favor bags for the fitness classes I teach. I also put in pretty net body scrubbers and plenty of Easter candy. I loved the variety of fragrances and tried to match the color of the bath bomb to each scrubby, as they were white with a different color intertwined; blue, pink, yellow , purple, etc.. Each bath bomb smelled wonderful. I didn't have any of the 40 left over for me to try, so I don't know how they perform. I'll have to ask my class. I only gave them 4

I have received 5 of these sets. The very first 2 were amazing. They were big, well scented, moisturizing, and lasted a very long time. The 2nd set would fall apart, dissolved very fast and didn't have much scent. This last order were smaller , did have a good scent and dissolved at about average. I will continue to shop around for the best option but I would purchase again.

This was purchased as an early Easter gift for our young grandchildren, ages 2 and 4. Candy is prohibited, so this was a substitute and the colorful packaging and the fact that it turned the bath water colors delighted them. They smell great.  I can't comment on the moisture rising because I did not use them!

reviews.t: Two thumbs up from mom and toddler!
reviews.x: Originally ordered these for my toddler for some bath time fun; however, now I'm hooked too! My son loves picking a new color every night and watching it spin and fizz in the water. Colors are vibrant and no irritation to his extremely sensitive skin so two thumbs up from me!  I'll be ordering more for sure.

I will honestly probably end up getting another case of these, just to put in the guest room. While the diversity of colors is ok, they all smell the exact same, and the colors, depending on which one you get, are pretty weak, once they dissolve. It is still a nice smell though, and they look good in jars.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the bath bombs smell amazing and are highly fragrant.
Several reviewers praise the large size and good value of the product.
Some reviewers report the bath bombs leave dark color or sediment stains on the tub.
A few reviewers complain about weak or nonexistent scent and poor fizzing.
Some reviewers mention the product leaves skin feeling soft and smooth.
